scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — additional base-game and early-DLC omissions

records.name: Double Sunday
records.effect: Fires two quick Ki blasts in succession; the second blast can knock the opponent away.

records.name: Full Power Energy Blast Volley
records.effect: Creates a large volley of Ki blasts that rains down in front of the user.

records.name: Super Volley
records.effect: Launches a rapidly repeating volley of Ki blasts while the user remains in place.

records.name: Flash Chaser
records.effect: Fires a fast tracking Ki blast that can be followed by additional shots.

records.name: Die Die Missile Barrage
records.effect: Launches a series of tracking explosive Ki projectiles that converge on the target.

records.name: Paralyze Beam
records.effect: Fires a narrow beam that temporarily paralyzes the opponent on hit.

reconciliation_note: All six names were absent from the repository's local docs/data/skills.json before this batch. They are retained as Super/Ki Blast records with mentor acquisition routes; no unsupported PQ or Ultimate Finish requirements were substituted.
